cohort: Pregnant women admitted for delivery at Ho Teaching Hospital in Ghana between October 2019 and March 2020.
finding: The overall stillbirth incidence was 31.3 per 1000 births, with pregnancy/delivery at 28-34 weeks' gestation significantly increasing the odds of stillbirths.
mod_finding: Induction of labour was significantly associated with an increased odds of stillbirths (AOR 11.06).
birth_weight: Measured as a variable, low birthweight was associated with increased odds of stillbirths.
gest_age: Measured as a variable, pregnancy/delivery at 28-34 weeks' gestation was significantly associated with increased odds of stillbirths.
